name: H na Kanojo (Natsu)
source:
You got a girlfriend!
Show the unsophisticated kawaii junior
how grownups feel good.

This loli sim game puts you on a date with Azusa-chan.
How far can you take her affection?

 [From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE151651.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
你有女朋友了！
展现淳朴的卡哇伊少年
大人感觉如何良好。

这款萝莉模拟游戏让你与小梓约会。
你能把她的感情带到什么程度？

 [来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE151651.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
